resources.string: Check if a service is down for others, on Downdetector
Opens Downdetector in your browser. Able does not fetch outage data itself.
Detected from SIM, network or language · %1$s
Type the name of an app, website or provider.
If Downdetector has no page with that exact name, it shows \"not found\": open the homepage and use its search instead.
No favourites yet. Type a service and tap Add to favourites.
No browser on this device can open this link.
Links open in your browser. Downdetector sees your visit like any website; Able sends nothing to it.

Downdetector collects user reports of problems with apps, websites and network providers, per country.

Able only opens Downdetector's pages in your browser. It does not download or show outage data itself because Downdetector offers no public API and its rules do not allow automated access: its robots.txt blocks generic crawlers and its pages are protected against non-browser clients.

Country: Able picks it from your SIM or mobile network, then your language, and you can change it. Only countries whose Downdetector site was checked are listed; others use downdetector.com.

Your country choice and favourites are saved only on this device.
